notes.title: Big changes are coming to the game system and rules
notes.notes:
I've been studying complex system science lately, so I've got some ideas for a game that will add a lot of dynamics to the system, introduce a lot of new rules, and aim for infinite levels and dynamic balancing. The goal is infinite levels and dynamic balancing. If you follow my idea, the system of this game will change dramatically.
